scope: Re-audit of ten existing fixed-input GPU media conditions; not a new model execution
sampler: Persistent read-only native PDH query; process creation and UTC clock consistency verified
memory_scope: Sampled whole Unity process allocation; not SDK-exclusive allocation, physical capacity or guaranteed peak
timing_scope: Whole API/stage wall and whole process CPU time; submission timestamps include command queue and copies; not exclusive kernel time
